rows.text: Forgot what you agreed on in that meeting? Your Mac didn't.
LokalBot records your calls locally. No bot joins the meeting. Then it writes up the recap and every decision.
Each one links back to the exact moment it was said.
So when you write the follow-up, it already knows. Just hit Tab.
It's free, open source, and the AI runs on your Mac. It's called LokalBot.
